sections.text_helper: Section 4.5.13 "BSEC unmap register (BSEC_UNMAPR)" in chapter 4 (Boot and security control (BSEC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 220.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0xE24
Reset value: 0xXXXXXXXX
Note: The reset value is 0xA1C0DE0D on a BSEC-closed device, 0xFFFFFFFF on a
BSEC-open device.
Register bits cannot be cleared by application, they can only be set to 1.
Secure privileged read and write only. Illegal reads return 0, illegal writes are ignored. Only
BootROM code can access.
Bits 31:0 UNMAP[31:0]: Unmap key
If this bitfield equals 0xA1C0DE0D, the whole ROM is visible, else ROM is partially hidden.
